receipt.public_excerpt: in October 2024, Gemini’s user numbers were 9 million daily and 90 million monthly.

evidence_items.explanation: About 90 million monthly Gemini users in October 2024 is a sizeable absolute consumer audience. That cuts against 'categorically failed' on an absolute reading.

receipt.public_excerpt: Meta AI was nearing 500 million monthly users as of September 2024, while OpenAI recently said that its weekly active users top 400 million.

evidence_items.explanation: Rivals had several times Gemini's audience, which supports the relative reading that Google's consumer push lagged badly.

receipt.public_excerpt: as of March 2025, Gemini had 350 million monthly users worldwide, and 35 million daily users.

evidence_items.explanation: Gemini's audience roughly quadrupled to 350 million monthly users within weeks of the post. This is just outside the target period, so it is context only.

unresolved_gaps: Microsoft disclosed no consumer-only Copilot user count for the period; its later figures combine consumer and commercial users.
Neither company breaks out spending on its consumer AI apps, so 'burning billions to do so' cannot be tied to the consumer push.
'Categorically failed' has no threshold, and the usage data support a relative reading while cutting against an absolute one.
